name: 2026-10-07-rental5-v2-gh200
status: REGISTERED MODEL CHANGE (no unit, no GPU): model v2; its re-predictions of earlier tests are SEEN DIAGNOSTIC, no verdict
design: design-r5 DESIGN.md part 1 with REVIEW.md section (a) (CAL-counters label, IN-SAMPLE labels, OLMoE's BLIND-CALMODEL basis)

model.v2: M with D: d = V2_DEAD_NS per dead CTA replaces DEAD_CTA_NS 1.333; kappa = V2_KAPPA replaces k_w in the dead window, hidden = kappa occ_g S'_g c; T0, c, bw, s_small, s_block refit on the CAL 8x7B 2026-09-27 pages

d_kappa_fit.label: CAL-counters: fitted on the in-kernel SHARED - NATIVE gap of the four CAL models' counter pages (rental 4 register.py fit_D, from offset/work/deadfit.json rows); 8x22B, Qwen2-57B and OLMoE are also held-out TIME-test models, their counter pages SEEN

refit_8x7b.label: CAL: the five 2026-09-27 mixtral_8x7b timed pages (G 2, 3, 4, 8, 32) and 2026-09-27-r3-counters/lock1710, the cross-model source set; no held-out page enters

model.no_new_constant: v2 adds kappa only; d replaces DEAD_CTA_NS
model.kappa_reading: the tp2 lever (9 against 32 copies on mixtral-8x7b-tp2) was CUT by the owner on 2026-10-07; kappa is read from the stamps only (docs/registered/2026-10-07-rental5-stamps2-gh200, D2 hiding)

Dg.label: SEEN: rental 4's printed per-GEMM d (A1 d_w2, A2 d_w1); a printed rival column, never a model

D2.label: SEEN-fitted on all 16 GEMMs (8 CAL, 8 held-out), principles/work/dead_ratio.py

recorded_not_adopted.rule: each enters only as a printed rival column (Dg, D2) in score_v2seen and the rental-5 dead rivals

flagged.M1_model_change: a --dead-model {m,v2} switch in r3_timing_model; the default stays m, so every earlier scorer's output is byte-identical
flagged.code_pins: r3_timing_model.py's sha changes; the rental-4 registrations' code_pins record the old sha (85ef38c), those registrations were scored and are not re-run

tests: cross_model_score targets: 8x22B, Qwen2-57B, OLMoE, Qwen1.5, Phi-3.5, JetMoE (and Granite-3.0-3B, printed with no expected value)
rental 3 E2 (counted bytes) and E1 (registered q_pred)
rental 4 A1 and A2 (measured Delta beside M's and v2's)
jetmoe-floor and mixtral-floor: floor slopes in cycles per CTA k-step, no dead term: unaffected
re_predictions.each_twice: as registered (model M) and under v2, the 8x7B source refit under each
re_predictions.set: SHARED + PRIVATE under rental 3's host rule (T_pred + F240 >= 0.40 ms, F240 0.067551 ms)
re_predictions.printed: rms, worst, bias (mean e), per-arm mean us, and r5common.secondary (calibration in logs, descriptive below 6 clusters; gamma)

labels.mixtral-8x22b, qwen2-57b-a14b, olmoe-1b-: IN-SAMPLE (d, kappa): their counter pages are in the CAL-counters set, so v2's dead term is in-sample on them; NOT held-out

expected_rule: score_v2seen must reproduce every expected value (M and v2) to 0.01 point, or it exits 1

labels.olmoe_skew: OLMoE's skew cells are BLIND-CALMODEL only because OLMoE's counter pages are in the CAL-counters set; no OLMoE time page enters any v2 fit

seen_data: d, kappa are CAL-counters (fitted on four models' counter pages, three of them held-out time models)
the expected table is SEEN (OFFSET.md, computed on published pages)
